atoms.b: Hello Ming, I'm thinking about doing an exchange program next year with an American student. I'm not quite sure if I want to do it, since I don't know a lot about American schools. You did that last year, right? Can you tell me a bit about the school you have been to?

Of course. So, last year I went to Kemper Larry High School, which is in Texas. It is a huge school with 4103 students. It has two separate campuses, one for freshmen and sophomores and the other for juniors and seniors.

atoms.b: So, did you like your stay abroad in the USA, and would you recommend it to me?

Of course, it was a great time. I loved going to KLHS. The school has many extracurricular activities. From arts and crafts to sports, you can find everything you want. I joined the drawing and cheerleading club. It was fun!

atoms.b: If you decide to go to the USA, you should also know that they have a different grading system. So, don't be confused if you get an A in an exam. They also have six grades, but they use letters instead of numbers. For instance, the German grade 1 is an American grade A.
